cards.text: David, Israel's king, has settled into his palace, a house of cedar. I spent years under a takeout menu in a junk drawer, friend, so to me that's a MANSION. Now David talks with Nathan the prophet about what's on his mind.

cards.question: David is living in a house of cedar. Where does he tell Nathan the ark of the covenant of the LORD is?
Nathan hears David out and tells him to go ahead and do all that is in his heart, because God is with him.

cards.text: Green light, done deal, easiest day a prophet ever had. Then that night, the word of God comes to Nathan.

cards.question: God gives Nathan a message for David about the house David wants to build for Him. What does the LORD say?

answers.text: David is not the one to build it
David should build it out of stone
David should build it in Hebron

cards.text: Then God explains. From the day He brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, He has not dwelt in a house, but has moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.

cards.question: In all His journeys with Israel, God had asked the leaders He appointed to shepherd His people why they hadn't built Him a house of cedar.
Now God reminds David where he started. Before making him ruler over His people Israel, God took David from following the ___.

cards.text: From following sheep to ruling Israel, friend, that's not a promotion, that's skipping the WHOLE ladder. And God has been with David wherever he's gone, cutting off all his enemies from before him.

cards.question: God has been with David everywhere he's gone. Now what does God say He will make for David?
God says that once He plants His people Israel in a place of their own, the sons of wickedness will still oppress them.

cards.text: God also says He will subdue all of David's enemies. And then, friend, hold on to your apron.

cards.question: David wanted to build a house for God. What does God declare to David instead?

answers.text: The LORD will build a house for David
The LORD will give David a bigger army
The LORD will bring the ark into David's palace

cards.text: That's like offering your neighbor ONE cookie and getting handed the WHOLE bakery. When David's days are fulfilled, God says, He will raise up one of David's own sons and establish his kingdom.

cards.question: God will raise up one of David's own sons after him. What will that son build?
God says He will establish the throne of David's son, and it will last ___.
God says He will be a Father to David's son. What does God say He will never remove from him?

cards.text: God will set David's son over His house and His kingdom forever. Then Nathan relays every word of this whole revelation to David.
Nathan's done. Now King David goes in, sits before the LORD, and starts to talk.

cards.question: David has just heard every promise God made about his house. What's the first thing he asks the LORD?

answers.text: Who am I that You brought me this far
When will my son build Your house
Why can't I build Your house myself

cards.text: Friend, the back of a junk drawer will teach you a 'who, ME?' real quick. Then David says that, as if all that were a small thing in God's eyes, God has spoken about the future of his house too.

cards.question: David asks what more he can say to God for honoring His servant, because God ___ His servant.
David says God has done this great thing for the sake of His servant. According to whose heart did God do it?

cards.text: Then David turns from himself to God. He tells the LORD there's none like Him, and no God but Him.

cards.question: Next David asks who is like God's people Israel. What did God go out to do for them?

answers.text: Redeem them as a people for Himself
Count them as an army for Himself
Gather them into one city for Himself

cards.question: David says God made His people Israel His very own for a little while.
After all that praise, David finally makes his request about God's word for his house. What does he ask?

answers.text: Let me build the house anyway
Give me more years to reign

cards.text: When somebody hands you the WHOLE bakery, friend, you don't haggle, you just say YES, please! And David wants it done so God's name will be established and magnified forever.

cards.question: David wants God's name magnified forever. What does David say people will say about the LORD of Hosts?
Because God revealed He will build a house for David, David says he has found the ___ to pray before Him.

cards.text: David starts to wrap it up. The LORD is God, he says, and He has promised this goodness to His servant.

cards.question: David ends his prayer by saying his house will be blessed forever.
